title: Clean Architecture
description: Organize code into concentric layers with dependency inversion.

data.text:
**Clean Architecture**

Enforces separation of concerns by dividing an application into layers: Entities, Use Cases, Interface Adapters, and Frameworks.

data.title: Clean Architecture Sketch
Key Takeaways
points: Core logic is independent of frameworks
data.takeaway: Clean Architecture keeps the domain pure and infrastructure swappable.
